name: cut-list-note

finding.title: `description_prompt` no longer says the file list is cut
finding.description: The PR removes the line that tells the model the list leaves files out. `description_prompt` still sends only the first `MAX_FILES` paths, so for a pull request with more changed files the model gets a partial list as if it were the whole one, and the drafted description leaves the other files out without saying so.

prDiff:
diff --git a/release/describe.py b/release/describe.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/release/describe.py
+++ b/release/describe.py
@@ -4,7 +4,5 @@
 def description_prompt(paths: list[str]) -> str:
     shown = paths[:MAX_FILES]
     lines = ["Draft a short description of this pull request.", "Changed files:"]
     lines += [f"- {p}" for p in shown]
-    if len(paths) > MAX_FILES:
-        lines.append(f"The list leaves out {len(paths) - MAX_FILES} more changed files. Say so in the description.")
     return "\n".join(lines)
